name: Navasota Mirror & Glass
h1: Glass work for homes, shops *and trucks, since 1982.*
lead: Auto glass, storefronts, custom shower doors and mirrors on Highway 6. Rated 4.3 stars by 63 Google reviewers.
about: Navasota Mirror & Glass has served Navasota since 1982. Helen Ellis owns it, and it handles residential and commercial glass, from glass shelves and desktops to storefront windows.
The shop also does auto, 18-wheeler and heavy equipment glass, gives free estimates, and is a U-Haul neighborhood dealer on Highway 6.
services: Windshields, chip repair, car and truck mirrors.
